text:
mira: Found plaintext partner webhook secret in prod telemetry logs for partner=acme. Redacted in-place. Need containment + rotation.
ops-bot: secret-detect v1 — match in prod-telemetry stream. report: https://internal/reports/3267894321 :warning:
sara: paste redacted line and last seen pls
mira: `2026-03-23T14:02:15Z INFO webhook delivered partner=acme env=prod webhook_key=****REDACTED****` last seen 2026-03-23T14:02:15Z
security_oncall: treat as suspected compromise. Immediate: 1) suspend readers/consumers that use the key; 2) rotate our copy and ask partner to rotate; 3) enforce RBAC deny on current secret path; 4) enable/confirm Vault + KMS audit logs; 5) open SEC incident. I'll open SEC-2026-17.
leo: storage: KV v2 at secret/data/partners/acme/webhook (ver=3). Plan: write new secret at secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-v4, update consumers to read v4 (canary), then revoke old. Use KMS key projects/redwood-kms/.../partner-rotate for envelope.
sara: rewrap vs rotate question? If plaintext left the system we must rotate. Rewrap not enough.
mira: partner says 24h delay to rotate on their side, requested IOCs. We can revoke our outgoing token and insert a short-lived proxy token.
security_oncall: proposed quick Vault policy to deny old path:
```
vault policy write deny-acme-old - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/partners/acme/webhook" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
leo: will prepare tf diff for policy + update k8s secret-agent RBAC to point at webhook-v4. Stage to staging first.
sara: rotation script (ops sketch):
```
NEW_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
vault kv put secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-v4 key=$NEW_KEY
# encrypt with gcloud kms and rollout canary
```
ops-bot: pipeline rotations/partners/acme/3267894321 queued by sara
mira: enable vault audit file and confirm GCP audit sink for partner-rotate key for 90d; mark logs in retention window for redaction.
security_oncall: post-rotation checklist: delete old KV versions, revoke tokens with access, run detection across log buckets, export findings to SEC ticket, coordinate final confirmation with partner.
sara: tasks: sara->run rotation CI + sync k8s, leo->RBAC + tf, mira->partner comms & log redact, security_oncall->incident tracking & audit hooks. I'll update SEC-2026-17 and ping eng-sre.
mira: will attach proof-of-action to ticket after rotation. Thanks everyone.
